title: Isolation of Total RNA with the Life Technologies PureLink Kit
protocol: Label the box and all buffers with the date received when using a new PureLink RNA isolation kit.
Dispose of leftover buffers properly once all spin cartridges in a kit are used.
Prepare fresh lysis buffer immediately before use by adding 1% 2-mercaptoethanol to it.
Work in a clean space and use filter tips to prevent RNase contamination of reagents and samples.
Wear gloves and safety glasses at all times during the protocol execution.
Add 300 mL of 100% ethanol to Wash Buffer II when using a new kit.
Label the buffer container and lid with the date indicating that ethanol is added.
Mix Lysis Buffer with 2-mercaptoethanol to achieve a final concentration of 1%.
Aliquot the required amount of the prepared Lysis Buffer for the procedure.
Prepare a fresh aliquot of 70% ethanol in RNase-free water.
Mix 8 μL of 10X DNase I Reaction Buffer into an Eppendorf tube.
Add 10 μL of resuspended DNase (~3U/μL) to the Eppendorf tube.
Add 62 μL of RNase-Free Water to the Eppendorf tube.
Ensure the final volume in the Eppendorf tube is 80 μL.
Blot basal surfaces with Kimwipes and transfer inserts into new, clean wells.
Carefully aspirate the medium from the apical compartment.
Rinse the apical surface with 400 µL of PBS for 24 mm inserts or 200 µL of PBS for 12 mm and 6.5 mm inserts. Aspirate the PBS wash.
Add 300 µL of Lysis Buffer (with 1% 2-mercaptoethanol) to the apical surface for 24 mm inserts, or add 250 µL for 12 mm inserts, or add 200 µL for 6.5 mm inserts.
Using a cell scraper or wide-bore pipette tip, dislodge cells from the membrane and collect in new, clean Eppendorf tube.
If samples are particularly viscous, shear cells 3-5 times with either a pipette tip or 1 mL syringe.
Proceed to RNA Purification or store samples at -80°C.
Aspirate the medium from the basolateral compartment.
Add 300 µL of Lysis Buffer (with 1% 2-mercaptoethanol) for 6-well plates, pipette up and down while distributing across the well surface.
Transfer the lysate to individual Eppendorf tubes for each sample.
Proceed to RNA Purification or store samples at -80°C.
Mix one volume of 70% ethanol with each volume of cell homogenate.
Vortex samples thoroughly until precipitate is in solution.
Transfer up to 700 µL of the sample to a spin cartridge.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 30 seconds at room temperature. Aspirate the flow-through and reinsert the spin cartridge into the same collection tube.
Repeat steps 3-4 until the entire sample has been processed.
Add 350 µL Wash Buffer I to the spin cartridge.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 30 seconds at room temperature. Aspirate the flow-through.
(Optional-DNase) Add 80 μL PureLink DNase mix directly onto the surface of the spin cartridge membrane.
(Optional-DNase) Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
(Optional-DNase) Add 350 µL Wash Buffer I to the spin cartridge.
(Optional-DNase) Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 30 seconds at room temperature. Aspirate the flow-through.
Place the column into a new collection tube.
Add 500 μL of Wash Buffer II (with ethanol added) to the spin cartridge.
Invert once and let sit for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 30 seconds at room temperature.
Aspirate the flow-through.
Add 500 μL of Wash Buffer II (with ethanol added) to the spin cartridge.
Close cap, invert tube, and incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 30 seconds at room temperature.
Aspirate the flow-through.
Centrifuge the spin cartridge for 4 minutes at 12,000 x g at room temperature to dry the membrane with bound RNA.
Discard the collection tube and insert the spin cartridge into a labeled recovery tube.
Add RNase-free water to the center of the spin cartridge in the appropriate volume:
For NHBE and 16HBE cells: 150 μL for 24 mm, 100 μL for 12 mm, 50 μL for 6.5 mm
For IMR90 and primary fibroblasts: 50 μL for 6-well and 40-50 μL for 12-well
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge the spin cartridge for 2 minutes at 12,000 x g at room temperature to elute RNA from the membrane into the recovery tube.
Discard columns.
Vortex samples.
Short spin for 10 seconds to collect sample in the bottom of the tube.
Store purified RNA on ice.
Vortex RNA samples.
Use 2 µL to quantify and check sample purity using a Nanodrop Spectrophotometer.
Proceed with cDNA synthesis or store samples at -80°C.
